title: For me, for you: nekem, neked, neki

sections.title: Whom it suits
sections.content: *Nekem* (for me), *neked* (for you) and *neki* (for him/her) say for whom something is good. With *jó* they make the pattern for plans: *Nekem jó.* (It suits me.) *Neked jó szombaton?* (Does Saturday suit you?) The plural forms are *nekünk*, *nektek* and *nekik*. Use the pronoun: *Neki jó.* New words: *nekem, neked, neki, nekünk, nektek, nekik*.

items.english: The afternoon does not suit him/her.

sections.content: *Nekem* is not *én*. *Én jó vagyok.* means 'I am good'; *Nekem jó.* means 'it suits me'.
